notes: The checkout contains 106 tracked .cbl/.cpy files and 55 tracked .jcl files (161 combined), plus BMS and other source assets. The mainframe application also contains BMS and other source assets.

app/jcl/READACCT.jcl includes an EXEC PGM=CBACT01C step, providing direct source evidence of the batch invocation relationship.

CBACT01C.cbl includes CVACT01Y.cpy and CODATECN through COPY statements. This sample establishes COBOL source, copybook, batch-JCL, and file-I/O patterns, but does not claim exhaustive coverage of the full CardDemo application or its optional CICS/DB2/IMS/MQ extensions.

All scored map categories are empty because the current map vocabulary has no first-class COBOL, copybook, JCL-job, VSAM, or CICS model. These unknown coverage statuses should not be read as evidence that the repository has no components, workloads, interfaces, or capabilities.
